title: Opening Range Extension Targets
summary: Of the sessions whose opening range first broke in the given direction, how often price extended at least r times the range beyond the broken side. Re-run across a ladder of r values and the hit rates trace the extension curve; the attached distribution of realized extensions gives the same curve from one run. The denominator is breaking sessions only: multiply by the break rate for per-session odds.

params.name: r
params.doc: Extension target in range multiples (1 = one full range beyond the broken side).

deltas: r is continuous: the target ladder is yours, not a fixed 0.5/1/2 menu
the realized-extension distribution shows the whole curve in one query
N + 95% CI per rung keeps thin ladders honest
